LanguageData.RC_Text_7d11cf7ffb572b39:
Patrol report
The unidentified target wore red-and-white power armor and did not respond to identification challenges.
Despite repeated hits, it continued to advance without any injury sufficient to halt its movement.
The target returned fire with extreme force, killing several Imperial marines and tearing apart multiple light exoskeletons with its bare hands.
Knight combat record
A reinforcing knight engaged the target with APFSDS rounds from a 120 mm main gun mounted on a heavy exoskeleton. Combat records confirm four hits. The target fell after the fourth hit and was subsequently confirmed dead.
Equipment inspection
Post-combat inspection confirmed that the target's armor remained completely undamaged. Available evidence cannot explain its material or protective mechanism. The equipment's origin remains unknown.
Attachments
Gunnery records, on-site footage, equipment inspection photographs and coordinates of the area where the target was last observed. The area has been sealed, but a follow-up search has not been completed.

LanguageData.RC_Text_5705c49afda83471: (Chuckles) Sure. Better than Shepherd, isn't it?
LanguageData.RC_Text_39051c3407dfe3ca: Our terrain scan found an outpost near the target with technology far beyond local capabilities. Its insignia does not belong to the Sophia Empire.
LanguageData.RC_Text_c3dbf5813b6e304b: By the way, there is no chance of a covert approach here. These soldiers are well equipped and armed to the teeth.
LanguageData.RC_Text_15a03996a0557942: Mason, reach the archotech structure at the center and bring back the data our phase-smith needs.
LanguageData.RC_Text_65eeca071fb19409: I have warped a forge in nearby.
LanguageData.RC_Text_ae27fbb3c7afd11f: We have also detected archotech structures radiating energy at this outpost. You can extract Solarite from them.
LanguageData.RC_Text_c02f0c0b7d3f60e8: Happy hunting, David. Stay focused. We are all counting on you.
LanguageData.RC_Text_ff0b26d1937435fb: Select Mason's C7 Templar assault rifle.
LanguageData.RC_Text_d2214f4c2ccbf465: Apply the loadout to finish the modification.
LanguageData.RC_Text_b72b217a9b67e32d: Good work. You can modify your weapon at the forge.
LanguageData.RC_Text_3be6fa36133826f7: Activated. Let me tap into their power circuit. Time to collect a maintenance fee.
LanguageData.RC_Text_5189915e35b404ec: The channels on the obelisk go dark. The sequence has reset.
LanguageData.RC_Text_7ee019f0b7ab20cb: Looks like there is more than one of the creatures mentioned in that report.
LanguageData.RC_Text_8a1e5de822c3200f: Copy. You can place the equipment now.
LanguageData.RC_Text_b3cd0314630913d1: Do not face that rotary cannon head-on. Get to cover!
LanguageData.RC_Text_69c71b05af4ad055: Received. Our phase-smith has started analyzing the data.
LanguageData.RC_Text_3cfb1ef8946d4deb: Wait, David. We just picked up an intense reality distortion near you.
LanguageData.RC_Text_ad55a9414641da9c: What the fuck is that thing?
LanguageData.RC_Text_2c25bfa970ee549a: Damn it, get out of there, David!
LanguageData.RC_Text_c14e93bd68e9f1a3: A local. After the noise you made at this outpost, He has noticed us. We need to leave. We cannot take on a Champion Warrior.
LanguageData.RC_Text_100cd178381ec1bd: Impressive. But the Champion cannot die. We must leave before he gets back up.
LanguageData.RC_Text_f39b6aacb4998cdf: We can use these structures to slow that big guy down.
LanguageData.RC_Text_4558db5bb8a4ea36: Tearing walls down with your bare hands... are you really human?
LanguageData.RC_Text_d9e878b5f81d3dd0: It will buy us some time.
LanguageData.RC_Text_bd71f5616dba6547: Sorry I never introduced myself. I am Cassandra, a baroness of the Sophia Empire.
LanguageData.RC_Text_0e0753d8cefa2f0f: You are not from around here, are you?
LanguageData.RC_Text_55b645b48b8beba3: Our merchant ship was passing through. A few of our people went missing near this camp.
LanguageData.RC_Text_71b6338d98c98b73: They have probably become part of the Legion.
LanguageData.RC_Text_1c4ea318ab37881e: I am heading to those fanatics' base anyway. Want to join me? Your friends might still be alive.
LanguageData.RC_Text_8ddfab8cbd170735: If you are interested, our outpost is nearby.
LanguageData.RC_Text_47f5afccd9d70643: Return to the Aurora first. We need to reassess this anomaly.
LanguageData.RC_Text_2944f37f6f71aa55: Cannot collapse the structure now: a safe escape route must remain.
LanguageData.RC_Text_cbe84b1393d9404e: The requirements for this interaction have not been met.
LanguageData.RC_Text_910c1ea83b4657d7: Script location marker, not a spawned entity. Moving it changes the corresponding camera or movement target.
LanguageData.RC_Text_96d691d1d5a803c1: Anomaly hub (scan after defeating the Centurion)
LanguageData.RC_Text_801f81c72e63f419: Extract Solarite and start the gunsmith tutorial
LanguageData.RC_Text_c482569f2daca632: Scan the anomaly hub and begin evacuation
LanguageData.RC_Text_0f18a1008f0b6305: Advance mission phase (1 explore / 2 Centurion / 3 scan / 4 escape)
LanguageData.RC_Text_c9bb82377117056f: Independent patrol route. Bound actors appear in Overview. Actors follow the listed waypoints and pause at checkpoints.
LanguageData.RC_Text_92523c47e305127e: Patrol waypoint. Click the route and its bound guards in Overview.
LanguageData.RC_Text_425b14638981598f: Interactive Romulus wall. During the chase, right-click it to collapse the adjacent passage. Overview links to its action and rubble footprint.
LanguageData.RC_Text_8939c2c0fa5afe02: Usable once during the chase. Operate the orange-highlighted wall to create native collapsed rocks and force a detour. The host wall remains. Shaded cells show the rubble footprint.
LanguageData.RC_Text_a3fa892039be1e3e: Communication hint only; spawns no rocks. Fires during the chase if the hint has not played. The linked wall interaction performs the actual collapse.
LanguageData.RC_Text_844fc87a5520fa19: Approach the linked building and right-click to use it. Conditions and rewards are listed below.
LanguageData.RC_Text_1c1a2fb28b63ed4d: Not spawned at start. Appears after the hub scan and guides the escape; the player controls only Mason.
LanguageData.RC_Text_7be004d773b3c557: Extracting grants 15 Solarite and starts the native gunsmith tutorial. Requires the forge to finish warping in; one use only.
LanguageData.RC_Text_35ba3b0d608a24c9: Warps in when Mason approaches after the entrance battle. This object sets the spawn position; the linked trigger sets the activation range.
LanguageData.RC_Text_b9acaf911253ec11: Scanning unlocks after the Centurion dies. Completing the scan starts the Champion chase and knight cinematic.
LanguageData.RC_Text_67e812e950576514: Location marker, not an extraction building. Use the Solarite extraction structure.
LanguageData.RC_Text_ca3b473394689765: Awards 30 Solarite after the optional sequence puzzle.
LanguageData.RC_Text_6c3811c0b2b1f8e6: Phase-three camera and dialogue marker; creates no entity.
LanguageData.RC_Text_1321324ad64f179e: The knight fires at the Champion here, then begins guiding Mason.
LanguageData.RC_Text_81a9eab9ccd3aa20: The mission completes when both Mason and the knight arrive.
LanguageData.RC_Text_298c3363709dd4cb: Switches the guide route when Mason approaches the western exit.
LanguageData.RC_Text_1f27a1bc66c1d0a9: Enter within 18 cells of the Centurion to begin phase two. Detection follows the boss.
LanguageData.RC_Text_8d9d9e50f9bce35d: Normal Centurion death advances to phase three and unlocks the anomaly hub scan.
LanguageData.RC_Text_f534ee67c61212f8: During phase two, accumulated damage to Mason triggers combat advice.
LanguageData.RC_Text_8cbbf3f455662086: Warns that the Champion cannot be permanently killed. The boss configuration handles the 77-second revival.
LanguageData.RC_Text_825ac109ef33b0c0: Plays once after a completed wall interaction sets m2-barrier-used.
LanguageData.RC_Text_53e59087f7e576a8: Mason and knight arrive: complete mission
LanguageData.RC_Text_5029ccd2000bed20: Requires the chase phase, the knight at extraction, and Mason within 8 cells.
LanguageData.RC_Text_99750949f11ddc36: During the chase, approaching the current western gate switches the knight to the western route. The final rendezvous remains north.
LanguageData.RC_Text_10226a11c7fd3eaa: After entrance battle: approach forge support
LanguageData.RC_Text_4cdf391362c3f697: Enabled after the entrance battle. Fires once when Mason enters its 10-cell radius, warping in the forge and unlocking Solarite teaching.
LanguageData.RC_Text_e6c17fa08c4e2546: Shared faction for this mission's Romulus defenders, turrets and structural walls.
LanguageData.RC_Text_da6defe57924f064: Leave through the selected exit, proceed directly to extraction, and wait for Mason.
LanguageData.RC_Text_153a9ab0b8159e77: Camera reference only. Lightning and arrival effects follow the Champion placement directly.
LanguageData.RC_Text_9a5a6d1d81dd84af: Pursue Mason in a straight line. Each wall or fallen-rock cell takes 1.5 seconds to breach. Explicitly enabled for this boss only.
LanguageData.RC_Text_ebb60fc12f399f4a: Cracked side wall. Activate during the chase to create fallen rocks. Each obstacle cell delays the Champion by about 1.5 seconds.
LanguageData.RC_Text_e05f400cd392952a: An interactive side wall with prominent cracks. Activate during the chase to create fallen rocks and delay the Champion.
LanguageData.RC_Text_c4929b0c87a6a9ca: We call them the Legion. They feel no pain, they never stop coming, and their technology far exceeds ours. I have lost many soldiers.
LanguageData.RC_Text_6b6590735b4f16ab: Our troops will advance from the west to buy you time. I hope your air support is enough.
LanguageData.RC_Text_9e2e24f514efbee0: Copy. I will infiltrate from the south.
LanguageData.RC_Text_09e3e1bfabf91ac5: Aurora, this is Mason. I have the designator. I will mark coordinates for your strikes.
LanguageData.RC_Text_b785024f9760a794: Mason, this is Prism Alpha. We are arriving above the planet. Stand by.
LanguageData.RC_Text_944dfbac7a72fbfb: Fire control, you are cleared to engage.
LanguageData.RC_Text_4a5b25db6f25d04d: Copy. Fire control, engage with the heavy-particle autocannon.
LanguageData.RC_Text_4ecc24e1b1486abe: Prism Alpha, there are turrets at the next position.
LanguageData.RC_Text_47cd069270f1a72c: Copy. Fire control, relativistic particle shots are now available.
LanguageData.RC_Text_d4c20088e7661f18: Kaldalis, there is a Champion at the next position.
LanguageData.RC_Text_ccaa3f8f5291d3c7: Copy. Fire control, the Executor authorizes low-power fire from the planet-fracture cannon.
LanguageData.RC_Text_d6afd217deb54982: The shields are down! Warriors of the Empire, fight for our home!
LanguageData.RC_Text_d75c57f3fd479d7d: This is the first time we have defeated those religious fanatics.
LanguageData.RC_Text_60dbd3e1e1684f54: Heavy. But we avenged our fallen comrades.
LanguageData.RC_Text_7a22135eb71c627f: Command wants an accounting for my unauthorized action. I may be suspended for a few days.
LanguageData.RC_Text_721d617eac2be916: They have serious concerns about your people.
LanguageData.RC_Text_902c869ef99198b0: I understand. But we will keep investigating Romulus.
LanguageData.RC_Text_7ef1ab7a7cfbe9c7: Karma just reported a new signal nearby.
LanguageData.RC_Text_3f7cd61ba9120e4b: Looks like violence did not solve the problem, eh?
LanguageData.RC_Text_992131cb6a4f8e2e: Bell and Adler are already on their way to investigate. Mason, we will warp you back first.
LanguageData.RC_Text_79fb7de3bdc5cdd7: The Legion base has been destroyed. Bell and Adler are investigating a new anomaly signal nearby.

LanguageData.RC_Text_7dc9e5f6b2ab426b: The Champion Warrior is dead and the final Romulus hub has been destroyed. A new anomalous signal has appeared nearby; Bell and Adler are investigating.
